Art. XII of the Constitution
provides that the State
owns, and has full control and supervision over all natural resources;
to be more effective in the development
and utilization
natural resources, there is a need to mobilize the entire government bureaucracy
and strengthen
the operations
and programs
relative to
minerals development;
under Section
10, Title III, Book II of the
Administrative
Code of 1987, the President
has the continuing
authority to
reorganize the administrative
structure of the Office of the President;
NOW, THEREFORE,
I, GLORIA MACAPAGAL-ARROYO,
President of
the Philippines,
by virtue of the powers vested in me by law, do hereby order:
There is hereby created a Minerals D~velopment
Council (MDC) under the Office of the President that shall have the primary
responsibility
of advancing the government policy of responsible and sustainable
development of the State's minerals resources.

The Chairman of the MDC, serving in an ex officio capacity, shall preside
at all meetings
of the MDC and ensure that all policies, directives,
programs of the MDC are faithfully carried out.
There shall also be an Executive Director with the rank of Undersecretary,
who shall be appointed
by the President and who shall manage the day-to-day
affairs of the MDC.
The representatives
from the members of the MDC shall have the rank of
Undersecretaries.
The Chamber of Mines of the Philippines shall be represented
by its President.
